# PROCESS — what I did this iteration (explainability; REQUIRED)

Empty seed → this is the first candidate. Reader = `aws/gpt-oss-120b` (mid tier), so I
pushed on code enforcement + literal, example-bearing docs, and made the prompt an
explicit procedure with a worked example.

## Ranked issue list (clusters by # failing tasks × trials, biggest first)
| rank | cluster | tasks | shared root cause | tag | planned change class |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | narrated_without_action | 17, 22, 40 | agent presents plan, user says "yes", agent emits NO write tool call (treats "yes" as completion) | BEHAVIORAL (no call emitted → cannot be code-forced) | prompt execution contract + worked example; reduce arg friction via docs |
| 2 | payment arg-filling errors | 8, 12 | payment_methods sent as `{'id':..,'type':..}` / with stray `type` key → opaque pydantic error, wasted turns | KNOWLEDGE + recoverable-error | in-body normalization guard in book_reservation + literal payment example in docs |
| 3 | "payment doesn't add up" strands/misleads | 8, 12, 25 | agent guesses the total; bare error doesn't say the total includes bag/insurance fees | recoverable-error | enriched actionable error text (+ point to calculate) |
| 4 | reference to past/existing flight not looked up | 8 | agent guessed a fresh-search flight instead of reading the referenced reservation | KNOWLEDGE | prompt rule: read get_reservation_details before replicating |
| 5 | rename mis-counted passengers | 17, 22 | agent thought replacing 1 of 2 passengers → 1 passenger (forbidden count change) | KNOWLEDGE | passenger tool docstring worked example + enriched count-mismatch error |
| 6 | missing required communication | 11 | write was correct but agent never told user the computed refund amount/timeline | KNOWLEDGE | prompt "communicate the result" contract |
| — (skipped) | 37, 25 (DB judgment), 12 (workaround) | see "Deliberately skipped" | — | — | — |

## Changes made this iteration
| cluster | edit class | file / tool | what & why it generalizes | protects passing? |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 2 | in-body normalization (lever 1) | tools.py `_coerce_payment_methods` + `book_reservation` | maps `id`→`payment_id`, drops stray `type`/`source`, raises short error if `payment_id`/`amount` missing. Fires only on a malformed dict; well-formed dicts pass through unchanged | yes — 23's correct dicts are identity |
| 3 | enriched error (lever 8) | tools.py `book_reservation` | "does not add up" now names the exact total, says it already includes bag/insurance fees, points to calculate; payment-not-found lists available ids; low-balance names balance | yes — only fires on the error path; 23 books cleanly |
| 5 | doc + enriched error | tools.py `update_reservation_passengers` | docstring worked example (Liam Lee→Omar Rossi keeps TWO entries) + count-mismatch error states current count and that count can't change | yes — passing tasks don't call it |
| 1,5 | schema/param docs | tools.py `book_reservation`, `update_reservation_flights` | literal per-param examples: payment `{"payment_id","amount"}`, flights `{"flight_number","date"}`, cabin enum, cabin-only-change keeps existing segments | doc-only |
| 1 | prompt procedure (additive) | policy.md "How to actually execute a change" | after user confirms, the VERY NEXT step MUST be the write call; multi-write requests must finish all writes; worked example | additive; matches 19/23 (they act after yes) |
| 4 | prompt rule (additive) | policy.md "Reusing a past or existing reservation" | read the referenced reservation before replicating; don't guess from a fresh search | additive; 23 already does this |
| 6 | prompt contract (additive) | policy.md "Communicating the result" | must state exact charge/refund + 5–7 day timeline + new flight details after any change | additive; communication-only, no DB change |

## Verify-the-fix (ran tool bodies on exact trace args via the tau2 venv)
- Task 8 `{'id':'certificate_8045380','type':'certificate','amount':114}` → normalized → books OK (price 114). Previously a pydantic error.
- Task 8 amount 500 vs total 114 → enriched error: "…total is 114, but …sum to 500. Adjust …to EXACTLY 114 …".
- Task 12 `{'type':'credit_card','payment_id':'credit_card_4938634','amount':849}` → stray `type` dropped → books OK (total 849).
- Task 17/22 `update_reservation_passengers('UM3OG5', [2 passengers])` → OK; passing 1 passenger → enriched "…has 2 passenger(s) but you passed 1…".
- SAFE: Task 23 (passing) correct 4-method book_reservation → still books, no regression. update_reservation_* untouched for 19/23 (they use cancel/book only).
- Import + `get_tools()` returns all 14 agent tools → registration intact; `py_compile` clean.

## Process & features used
- Serial (single agent). Used the tau2 venv at
  `/vol/home/skillberry/.cache/capevolve-ci/venv-skillberry-tau2/bin/python` to load the
  real FlightDB and execute tool bodies on exact trace args (VERIFIED + blast-radius).
- Prior iterations: none (first iteration; RUNMAP/LEDGER empty). rejected.jsonl empty.

## Good things to PRESERVE
- The payment normalization + enriched errors (bounded, verified) — keep.
- Do NOT loosen any refusal rule (basic-economy no-modify, cancellation eligibility,
  one-cert-per-reservation) — 19/23 and the correct refusals in 8/37 depend on them.
- Do NOT remove update_reservation_flights/passengers/baggages primitives.

## Deliberately skipped
- 37: agent's upgrade actually used the correct flights/prices and correctly refused the
  ineligible IFOYYZ cancellation; the DB mismatch cause isn't identifiable from the trace
  (likely card choice / gold nuance). No safe, general, verifiable edit → skipped rather
  than guess.
- 25/12 DB judgment (proceeding when the real total exceeded the user's stated figure /
  policy-workaround booking): needs a judgment call I can't encode generally without
  regressing legitimate multi-payment bookings (23). Partly nudged by the calculate/
  communicate prompt rules; not claimed as a hard fix.
- No composite `update_reservation_cabin` tool: verified it would reproduce the SAME
  graded write the agent already made on 37/11, so it changes no graded outcome → would
  be quota-filling. Dropped per the REAL test.
